meta.title: Implement lazy loading of networks
meta.body_summary: Implement lazy loading of social networks via dynamic imports, convert useSocialShare to async, and update components/docs accordingly.

perf_labels.notes: Codex implemented lazy loading via dynamic imports; tests failed, no human review; author closed PR after ~2 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 82 changed lines across 6 files, this is a small change by absolute volume. It replaces static imports with dynamic ones, which fits a small-scale performance refactoring PR. However, it was closed without merge due to failing tests and lack of human review engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot suggested replacing 'any' with a more specific type for the imported module in networksIndex.ts.
review_details.performance_claim: Lazy loading reduces bundle size and initial load time by only importing needed network modules on demand.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author closed PR without merge; PR body notes eslint and pnpm test failures, indicating functional issues preventing acceptance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Codex changed module loading strategy but the PR had failing tests (eslint missing config, test suite cancelled), suggesting incomplete handling of the build/test environment. The lack of human review and eventual closure by author indicate the agent output was not ready for merge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or performance measurements; only structural claim of improved loading due to lazy imports.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Author closed PR after ~2 days with failing tests; no regression fix cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced static imports of all social network modules with dynamic import.meta.glob in networksIndex.ts, making getNetwork async; updated useSocialShare to be async and await network import; adapted SocialShare.vue and playground pages to use top-level await.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation and playground pages updated to reflect async usage.
change_trajectory: Single commit: replaced static imports with dynamic imports, converted composable to async, and updated all usage sites.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot summarized PR changes and suppressed low-confidence comments.
Suggested replacing 'any' with a specific type for the module import in getNetwork to improve type safety.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by author with lazy load implementation.
Copilot bot reviewed within seconds, posted overview and type safety suggestion.
No human interaction; author closed PR after ~2 days without addressing failing tests.
